title: GetOrderAddressResponse
description: The response schema for the `getOrderAddress` operation.

errors.description: One or more unexpected errors occurred during the `getOrderAddress` operation.

CompanyName.description:
The company name of the recipient.

**Note**: This attribute is only available for shipping address.

AddressLine2.description: Additional street address information, if required.

AddressLine3.description: Additional street address information, if required.

CountryCode.description: The country code. A two-character country code, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

Phone.description:
The phone number of the buyer.

**Note**: 
1. This attribute is only available for shipping address.
2. In some cases, the buyer phone number is suppressed: 
a. Phone is suppressed for all `AFN` (fulfilled by Amazon) orders.
b. Phone is suppressed for the shipped `MFN` (fulfilled by seller) order when the current date is past the Latest Delivery Date.

ExtendedFields.description:
Extended address fields for additional address components including the street name or number. 

Note: Available for grocery sellers and Brazil shipping addresses.

AddressType.description: The address type of the shipping address.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: The shipping address is a residential address.
The shipping address is a commercial address.

Address.description: The shipping address for the order.

StreetNumber.description: The house, building, or property number associated with the location's street address.

Complement.description: The floor number/unit number in the building/private house number.

Neighborhood.description: The neighborhood. This value is only used in some countries (such as Brazil).

GeoCoordinates.description:
Latitude and longitude coordinates for the shipping address using the WGS84 coordinate system. 

Note: Available for sellers that support geographic coordinates.

AddressExtendedFields.description:
Extended address fields for additional address components including the street name or number. 

Note: Available for grocery sellers and Brazil shipping addresses.

BusinessHours.description: Business days and hours when the destination is open for deliveries.

OpenIntervals.description: Time window during the day when the business is open.

DropOffLocation.description: Drop-off location selected by the customer.

PreferredDeliveryTime.description: Business hours and days when the delivery is preferred.

OtherAttributes.description: Enumerated list of miscellaneous delivery attributes associated with the shipping address.

AddressInstructions.description: Building instructions, nearby landmark or navigation instructions.

DeliveryPreferences.description: Contains all of the delivery instructions provided by the customer for the shipping address.

code.description: An error code that identifies the type of error that occurred.

message.description: A message that describes the error condition.

details.description: Additional details that can help the caller understand or fix the issue.

Error.description: Error response returned when the request is unsuccessful.

ErrorList.description: A list of error responses returned when a request is unsuccessful.

ExceptionDates.description: Dates when the business is closed or open with a different time window.

ExceptionDate.description: Date when the business is closed, in ISO 8601 date format.

IsOpen.description: Boolean indicating if the business is closed or open on that date.

OpenIntervals.description: Time window during the day when the business is open.

Latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the shipping address using the WGS84 coordinate system.

Longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the shipping address using the WGS84 coordinate system.

GeoCoordinates.description: The latitude and longitude coordinates of the shipping address using the WGS84 coordinate system.

OpenInterval.description: The time interval for which the business is open.

StartTime.description: The time when the business opens.

EndTime.description: The time when the business closes.

OpenTimeInterval.description: The time when the business opens or closes.

Hour.description: The hour when the business opens or closes.

Minute.description: The minute when the business opens or closes.

AmazonOrderId.description: An Amazon-defined order identifier, in 3-7-7 format.

BuyerCompanyName.description: The company name of the contact buyer. For IBA orders, the buyer company must be Amazon entities.

ShippingAddress.description:
The shipping address for the order.

**Note**: `ShippingAddress` is only available for orders with the following status values: `Unshipped`, `PartiallyShipped`, `Shipped`, and `InvoiceUnconfirmed`.

OrderAddress.description: The shipping address for the order.

OtherDeliveryAttributes.description: Miscellaneous delivery attributes associated with the shipping address.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Indicates whether the delivery has an access point pickup or drop-off location.
Indicates whether pallet delivery is enabled for the address.
Indicates whether pallet delivery is disabled for the address.

PreferredDeliveryTime.description: The time window when the delivery is preferred.

BusinessHours.description: Business hours when the business is open for deliveries.

ExceptionDates.description: Dates when the business is closed during the next 30 days.
